name: a sealed policy in block YAML with comments
source:
# sealed, keyless
allowed_domains: []
first_use_approval: always_deny  # no review
min_confinement_class: CC1
auto_stop_after_sec: 900
eligible_grants:
  - kind: git_pat
    scope:
      host: github.com
      repos: [acme/one, "acme/two"]
    ttl_seconds: 3600
    requires_approval: false

name: the same policy as explicit JSON
CRLF line endings with a literal block marker
source:
llm_inspection:
  mode: block
  classified_markers:
    - |
      TOP SECRET
      line two
    - plain marker

name: U+0085, U+2028 and U+2029 as the console's YAML view writes them
the same characters as JSON escapes
numbers both readers read alike
source:
auto_stop_after_sec: 0
llm_inspection:
  max_scan_bytes: 1e6
eligible_grants:
  - kind: api_key
    ttl_seconds: 0xE10
  - kind: api_key
    ttl_seconds: 0o17

name: quoted look-alikes stay strings
source:
tool_rules:
  - tool: Bash
    pattern: "2000-10-07"
    effect: deny
  - tool: Bash
    pattern: '017'
    effect: hold
  - tool: Bash
    pattern: "3_600"
    effect: allow

name: YAML 1.1 words are strings in both readers
source: allowed_methods: [GET, yes, no, on, off, y, n]

name: strings that only start like numbers
a leading-zero integer

console.error: Leading zeros are ambiguous: remove them, or quote the value.

name: an unquoted date
source:
tool_rules:
  - tool: Bash
    pattern: 2000-10-07
    effect: deny

name: underscored digits
a raw U+0085 inside quotes

console.error: Unescaped U+0085: write it as \u0085 in a quoted string.

name: a bare CR line ending

a plain +_ number-like string
